# Orbyss.Foundation.Web.ProblemDetails.Core

Immutable bounded problem definitions, field diagnostics, reserved envelope names and application
failure mapping contracts. No HTTP, serializer or activation dependency. Definitions contain safe
public text only; exception messages, submitted values and provider diagnostics are never mappings.
